# EverBloom Studio

> Preserved botanicals and handcrafted goods, designed in Brooklyn, New York. The online shop’s instant checkout is opening soon. Counted cross-stitch and floral embroidery PDFs are bought via Payhip (instant PDF download, PayPal or card). Doll-clothes patterns are still ordered by email.

EverBloom Studio LLC was founded in New York in 2026. The studio makes preserved botanicals, handcrafted leather goods, ceramic mini vases, cross-stitch embroidery, vintage map prints, and custom city map posters. Finished goods come from small workshops and are tested in Brooklyn before they are listed for sale. Preserved botanicals come from a partner workshop in Lingyuan, Liaoning.

Three digital pattern lines are listed: counted cross-stitch PDF charts, floral hand-embroidery PDFs (surface embroidery, not cross-stitch), and sewing patterns for doll clothes drafted to fit most 18-inch dolls. Cross-stitch and embroidery patterns are bought via Payhip (instant PDF download, PayPal or card). Doll-clothes patterns are still ordered by email at info@everbloomstudio.us. The studio replies with the doll-clothes PDF and a payment link. Pattern files are not published on the website. Preview images are watermarked samples. There are no reviews and no sales figures on the site.

Wholesale inquiries are open for the preserved botanical line. Leather, ceramic, and cross-stitch lines open to retail partners as testing completes. The PDF patterns are direct studio downloads, not wholesale.

- Website: https://everbloomstudio.us/
- Email: info@everbloomstudio.us
- Location: Brooklyn, New York

## Counted cross-stitch PDF patterns

Wildflower Bouquet, 44×75 stitches, 10 DMC colors, beginner, $5.99. Rose Wreath, 86×87 stitches, 14 DMC colors, intermediate, $6.99. Blush Peony, 79×108 stitches, 16 DMC colors, intermediate, $7.99. Floral Bundle 3-pack (all three charts), $16.99. Golden Sunflower, 44×76 stitches, 11 DMC colors, beginner, about 3.1×5.4 in on 14-count, $5.99. Cherry Blossom Branch, 101×76 stitches, 11 DMC colors, confident beginner, about 7.2×5.4 in on 14-count, $6.99. Poinsettia & Holly Wreath, a Christmas cross stitch pattern with an open center for a name or date, 88×92 stitches, 10 DMC colors, intermediate, about 6.3×6.6 in on 14-count, $7.99. Seasonal Cross Stitch Bundle (Golden Sunflower, Cherry Blossom Branch, and Poinsettia & Holly Wreath), $16.99. Each PDF includes a color symbol chart, a black-and-white chart, a DMC floss key, and a stitching guide. These are counted charts, not the studio’s finished hoop collection, and not surface embroidery. Buy these charts via Payhip: instant PDF download, PayPal or card.

## Floral hand embroidery PDF patterns

Wildflower Meadow, 5-inch hoop, 8 DMC colors, beginner, $5.99. Botanical Wreath, 6-inch hoop, open center with space for initials, beginner–intermediate, $6.99. Peony & Rose Bouquet, 7-inch hoop, 13 DMC colors, intermediate, $7.99. Floral Embroidery Bundle, the three patterns, $16.99. Lavender Sprig, 5-inch hoop, 6 DMC colors, beginner, stem stitch, satin stitch, and lazy daisy, $5.99. Monogram Floral Frame, 6-inch hoop, 8 DMC colors, open center for an initial, $6.99. Winter Poinsettia, a Christmas embroidery pattern worked in thread painting, 7-inch hoop, 10 DMC colors, $7.99. Seasonal Embroidery Bundle (Lavender Sprig, Monogram Floral Frame, and Winter Poinsettia), $16.99. Each PDF includes an actual-size transfer, a mirrored transfer, a color and stitch guide, a stitch library, and a DMC list. Print the transfer at 100% and check the 1-inch test square. These are hand-embroidery patterns, not cross-stitch and not a finished stitched hoop. Buy these patterns via Payhip: instant PDF download, PayPal or card.

## Doll clothes sewing patterns

Printable PDF sewing patterns for most 18-inch dolls. Gathered Sundress, $6.99. Peter Pan Collar Blouse, $6.99. Skirt & Pajama Pants, $6.99. Doll Clothes 3-pattern Set, $16.99. Print at 100% (actual size) and measure the printed test square (1 inch and 3 cm). Seam allowances are included on the pieces. Describe the fit only as most 18-inch dolls. The patterns are not affiliated with, licensed by, or endorsed by any doll manufacturer, and the site does not use doll brand names. A Peter Pan collar is a rounded collar style, not a character and not a brand. Order these patterns by email at info@everbloomstudio.us. The studio replies with the PDF and a payment link.
